title: Stand up, Stand up for Jesus
lyrics_original: Stand up, stand up for Jesus, Ye soldiers of the cross;
Lift high His royal banner, It must not suffer loss:
From vict'ry unto vict'ry His army He shall lead,
Till ev'ry foe is vanquished, And Christ is Lord indeed.
Stand up, stand up for Jesus, The trumpet call obey;
Forth to the mighty conflict In this His glorious day:
Ye that are men now serve Him Against unnumbered foes;
Let courage rise with danger, And strength to strength oppose.
Stand up, stand up for Jesus, Stand in His strength alone;
The arm of flesh will fail you, Ye dare not trust your own:
Put on the Gospel armor, Each piece put on with pray'r;
Where duty calls, or danger, Be never wanting there.
Stand up, stand up for Jesus, The strife will not be long;
This day the noise of battle, The next the victor's song:
To him that overcometh A crown of life shall be;
He with the King of Glory Shall reign eternal.

bible_verses.english: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
You therefore must endure hardship, as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
Be watchful. Stand firm in the faith. Be courageous. Be strong.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my strength and my refuge when life feels overwhelming. Forgive me for the times I rely on my own frail wisdom instead of leaning on Your grace. Grant me the courage to stand firm in my faith today, showing Your love and truth to those around me. Lead me step by step in Your ultimate victory. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: In a world that often asks us to compromise, 'Stand Up, Stand Up for Jesus' reminds us where our true strength and allegiance lie. Following Christ is not a passive journey, but a call to courage rooted entirely in His victory. As we face life's daily battles, we are reminded that relying on our own strength will fail us, but standing in His mighty power brings unfailing peace. Today, take heart and lift high His name, knowing He walks ahead of us in every trial.
